Test Case Description: Verify successful logout blacklists tokens and redirects to login page
PreRequisites:
- User is logged in with valid access token and refresh token
- Tokens are stored in local storage
Steps to Perform: Click Đăng xuất button in navigation menu
Step Expected Result: Confirmation dialog appears: 'Bạn có chắc chắn muốn đăng xuất?'
Test Case Expected Result: User is successfully logged out. Access token is added to blacklist, refresh token is deleted from database, local storage is cleared, and user is redirected to login page.

Steps to Perform: Click Xác nhận button in confirmation dialog
Wait for logout processing to complete

Step Expected Result:
- Access token is added to blacklist (cannot be reused)
- Refresh token is deleted from REFRESH_TOKENS table
- Local storage is cleared (no tokens remain)
- User is redirected to login page
- Success message displayed: 'Logout successful'

Steps to Perform: Attempt to access protected page with old token
Step Expected Result: Access is denied with 401 Unauthorized error
